# Problem 1

Importing the NY NOAA data set from the p8105 library.

```{r}
library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")
```

The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Association data set contains weather data that are available from weather stations globally. The NY NOAA data set contains **`r nrow(ny_noaa)`** observations and **`r ncol(ny_noaa)`** variables. Variables include
**`r names(ny_noaa)`**. The data are collected from **`r min(ny_noaa$date)`** to **`r max(ny_noaa$date)`**. ID refers to the weather station ID from which data are collected. The range of values of precipitation is **`r range(ny_noaa$prcp, na.rm = TRUE)`**  (tenths of mm). The range of values of snowfall is **`r range(ny_noaa$snow, na.rm = TRUE)`** (mm). The range of values of snowdepth is **`r range(ny_noaa$snwd, na.rm = TRUE)`** (mm). The average maximum temperature is **`r round(mean(as.numeric(ny_noaa$tmax), na.rm = TRUE),1)`** (tenths of degrees C). The average minimum temperature is **`r round(mean(as.numeric(ny_noaa$tmin), na.rm = TRUE),1)`** (tenths of degrees C).
